thread:
Jin: quick sync — planning to roll rwinf-metadata:2026-04-01-alpha to prod Fri 07:00 PT. Need RN lint, CS email draft, and legal signoff before gate 2. I put a draft in drive: https://drive.company/rn/18321

Priya: I can run RN lint and copycheck. Will grep for TODOs and link the changelog. Can we pin the image to avoid late drift?

Len: pin to rwinf-metadata:2026-04-01-alpha-ok. Also want a dry-run deploy to staging first. DeployBot: can you dry-run?

DeployBot: /deploy plan --service rwinf-metadata --image rwinf-metadata:2026-04-01-alpha-ok --env staging

DeployBot: Dry-run plan created. Use /deploy start when ready for canary cadence.

Priya: RN lint findings: fixed a broken link, expanded the "impact" section to call out token costs and config changes, and added an action item for CS to update KB. Draft now: "Release: rwinf-metadata 2026-04-01-alpha-ok. Rollout: staggered canary (10%, 40%, 100%) with 10m gates. Owners: Jin (lead), Priya (docs/announce), Len (deploy/ops). Oncall: Oncall-Infra. Contact legal for any data classification concerns."

Legal-Bot: automated check: no PII flagged in RN draft. Manual legal review requested for new telemetry header — assigning to @LegalOps.

Jin: good catch. @LegalOps please try to sign off by EOD Thursday. We should not go to gate 2 without explicit thumbs from legal.

Len: ops note — quiet window 06:00-10:00 PT Friday; we'll run canary starting at 07:00 PT. Oncall-Infra, can you be primary gate watcher?

Oncall-Infra: Confirmed. I'll be on pager and will run the dashboard checks at +5m and +9m for each gate. Add me to the thread notifications.

Priya: Scheduling internal announce: post to #eng-releases at gate 2 (40%) and to #customer-success after gate 3 (100%). Can we attach a one-click rollback guide?

Len: Add rollback snippet to RN. Quick revert commands are:
```
DeployBot: /deploy rollback --service rwinf-metadata --to-image rwinf-metadata:2026-03-28-stable
kubectl rollout undo deployment/rwinf-metadata
```
Also include the emergency kill if needed: kubectl scale deploy rwinf-metadata --replicas=0

DeployBot: Ready to start canary. Command to execute when owners are ready: /deploy start --service rwinf-metadata --image rwinf-metadata:2026-04-01-alpha-ok --canary 10,40,100 --gate 10m

Jin: I'm green to start after legal thumbs. Priya, please queue the internal blurb but hold on posting. Len, Ops please trigger when legal is done.

Legal-Bot: Manual signoff received from @LegalOps at 2026-03-31T18:22:00Z. Legal: approved with note — monitor telemetry header for new idempotency token.

Len: Starting canary now. DeployBot?

DeployBot: /deploy start --service rwinf-metadata --image rwinf-metadata:2026-04-01-alpha-ok --canary 10,40,100 --gate 10m

DeployBot: Canary gate 1 (10%) started — posting gate updates here.

Oncall-Infra: Watching dashboards. Gate 1 checks at +5m: errors flat, 95p latency -10ms, token cost -2%. All green.

Priya: Gate 1 ok from docs/comms side. Moving queued announce to hold for gate 2.

DeployBot: Canary gate 2 (40%) started. Posting telemetry link: https://dash.company/canary/18321

Oncall-Infra: Gate 2 quick checks: small uptick in p50 (20ms) but p99 within baseline. No error surge.

Jin: Good. Priya, please post internal announcement now to #eng-releases using this copy: "Rolling rwinf-metadata -> 2026-04-01-alpha-ok. Expected low impact. Owners: Jin/Len/Priya. CS notification scheduled on full deploy. See RN: <link>. Contact Oncall-Infra for incidents."

Priya: Posted. Also flagged KB ticket for CS: CS-4231 scheduled to send after final gate.

DeployBot: Rollout to 100% started.

DeployBot: Rollout complete. 100% traffic. Status: success.

Jin: Thanks team. Post-deploy tasks: Priya — update changelog and KB; Len — leave canary snapshot for 24h; Oncall-Infra — keep monitoring for 6h. I'll close the release ticket after changelog update.

Priya: Changelog updated and CS KB queued. Marking RN as "released" in drive.

Len: Leaving canary snapshot for 24h. No evacuations needed.

Oncall-Infra: Monitoring until 13:00 PT. No anomalies so far.

Jin: Closing thread. Great run.
